scope: Every numbered theorem, proposition, lemma, corollary, definition and remark of paper/main.tex and its included section files is indexed in TeX order. Every field of the Lean propositions TR25.FiniteCertificate and TR25Family.FiniteCertificate is mapped to the declaration that proves it. No numbered paper result is claimed to be formalized in Lean in full; each Lean theorem is a finite certificate layer.

lean_projects.scope: Fourteen finite assertions about the integer witness in format 3x3x5 and its zero padding to 6x6x6: tensor equalities over the integers, nonzero and pairwise nonproportional summands, different decompositions, third-flattening ranks, six rational determinants and coordinate Jacobian ranks over the complex numbers. It has no border-rank, secant-dimension, tangent-space, normalization, conductor, S2, Cohen-Macaulay or depth premise or conclusion.

Fourteen finite assertions about the fixed integer witness in format 3x4x5: tensor equalities, nonzero and pairwise nonproportional summands, different decompositions, flattening ranks 3, 3 and 5, pair-product and third-factor ranks, six rational determinants and coordinate Jacobian ranks. It quantifies over no formats or ranks and has no geometric premise or conclusion; the number 50 is the rank of each coordinate Jacobian at this witness.

The same pairwise nonproportionality statement after padding to 6x6x6.
The same difference of the two lists after padding to 6x6x6.

The 36x6 third-mode flattening of the padded 6x6x6 witness has rank 5 over the complex numbers.

For both padded lists, the 216x90 coordinate Jacobian in format 6x6x6 has rank 80 over the complex numbers.

Every summand of each list is a nonzero complex tensor.
No summand of a list is a complex multiple of a different summand of the same list.

For both lists, the 15x5 matrix of the products of first and third factors has rank 5.
For both lists, the 20x5 matrix of the products of second and third factors has rank 5.

exact_checks.scope: Reads the integer factors in verification/core/verification/witness.json and checks, in format 3x3x5: exact integer equality of the two five-term decompositions, five distinct projective summand directions in each, distinct unordered decompositions, rank 5 of the three pair-product lists in both decompositions, rank 5 of the third flattening, and tangent matrix ranks 45 and, after padding to 6x6x6, 80 at both decompositions, by elimination modulo the prime 1,000,003, whose primality it checks.
exact_checks.limitation: One fixed rank-five witness. Modular ranks are lower bounds; the matching upper bounds come from the scaling-kernel argument of the paper.

exact_checks.scope: Constructs both decompositions directly from the matrix M, independently of the first checker, and checks integer equality, nonzero and distinct pure summands, different unordered decompositions, and tangent matrix ranks 45 and 80 at both decompositions modulo 101.
exact_checks.limitation: One fixed rank-five witness, with the same upper-bound argument.

exact_checks.scope: Independent integer and rational recomputation of the 3x4x5 certificate: tensor equality, nonzero and pairwise nonproportional summands, different decompositions, flattening ranks 3, 3 and 5, pair-product and third-factor ranks 5, the six ratio determinants, and rank 50 of both 60x60 coordinate Jacobians, all by full rational elimination.
exact_checks.limitation: One fixed witness; no geometric or all-rank conclusion.

exact_checks.scope: The torus-elimination polynomial identity in the proof of Lemma 7.2, det M = 2, the three row and three column tangent determinants (4.11) and (4.12), the determinant (4.15) as a polynomial identity, and the symbolic row and column arc coefficient identities of the proof of Proposition 7.4.
exact_checks.limitation: Fixed identities only; the normalization geometry and every universal quantifier are written proofs.

exact_checks.scope: For the six matrices Q_1, ..., Q_6: the circuit relation, rank 5 of the circuit and of every five of its matrices, the rank-one cycle equations at the six points with nonzero Jacobian determinants, and four polynomial elimination identities.
exact_checks.limitation: Fixed six-point core only; the all-rank valuation arguments, blowup geometry and normalization statements are written proofs.

exact_checks.scope: A byte-identical copy of the higher-rank core checker and certificate, run in the boundary-model suite: circuit relation and rank, independence of every five points, cycle-equation Jacobian determinants and elimination identities.
exact_checks.limitation: Finite core only; boundary normality, saturation, fibre exhaustion and the mixed-model geometry are written proofs.

exact_checks.scope: For the padded rank-five circuit with first two factor dimensions (3,4), (4,4) and (6,6), the exact dimensions of one branch tangent space, the common tangent space and the span of all six: 25, 23, 35; 30, 26, 50; and 50, 38, 110. Integer containments give the upper bounds and inverse certificates modulo 101 the lower bounds.
exact_checks.limitation: Three fixed formats; residue-map surjectivity, scheme gluing, branch exhaustion, the tensor-bundle passage and the depth calculation are written proofs.

exact_checks.scope: A byte-identical copy of the normalization identity checker, run in the local-ring suite. Its inputs to Theorem 7.10 are the torus-elimination identity, the six tangent determinants and det M = 2.
exact_checks.limitation: Fixed identities only; the avoidance and arc identities it also checks are not inputs to Theorem 7.10.

exact_checks.scope: Constructs the two integer decompositions of the family witness for all 15 pairs (r,p) with 5<=r<=9 and 3<=p<=r-2 (seed in format p x q x r and padded witness in p x (q+1) x r, q=r+1-p) and for the extension from 4x5x8 to 5x5x8, 31 pairs in all; checks tensor equality and distinctness over the integers, independence of matrix factors and third factors modulo 101, and addition-differential rank r(a+b+c-2) modulo 101.
exact_checks.limitation: Finitely many formats only; the uniform construction for every rank r >= 5 is the written proof of Proposition 4.6.

numbered_results.title: Failure of S2 and of Cohen-Macaulayness for the secant family
numbered_results.covered: For r = 5 the witness is the integer tensor T_5 padded to the target format. For its paddings to 6x6x6 and 3x4x5, Lean proves integer equality of the two five-term decompositions, that they are different, third-flattening rank 5 and coordinate Jacobian ranks 80 and 50; the exact checkers recompute these data.
numbered_results.paper_only: The theorem for every r and format in (1.2): the dimension D, failure of S2, non-Cohen-Macaulayness of R and of the local ring at T, the vertex-depth inequality (1.3), rank and border rank r of the witness, and the factor permutations. The proof in Section 5 combines Propositions 2.5, 3.3 and 4.6.

numbered_results.title: The rank-five examples and the unit-tensor orbit closures
numbered_results.covered: For the rank-five witnesses in formats 6x6x6 and 3x4x5: equality and difference of the two decompositions and coordinate Jacobian ranks 80 and 50. These are ranks of explicit matrices; they agree numerically with the stated dimensions but are not variety dimensions.
numbered_results.paper_only: Failure of S2, the dimensions 50, 80, 2r^2 and 3r^2-2r, the vertex-depth inequalities, the family X_r(3,r-1,r) and the orbit-closure identity (1.4).

numbered_results.title: Local non-Cohen-Macaulayness of the projective secant
numbered_results.covered: No Lean declaration or exact check is assigned.
numbered_results.paper_only: Non-Cohen-Macaulay local ring of the projective secant at the class of the witness, through the affine chart isomorphism with a Gm-bundle, and failure of arithmetic Cohen-Macaulayness.

numbered_results.paper_only: Independence of the P_i, the rank-one directions of their span, the tangent intersections (2.2) and reducedness of the scheme-theoretic intersection, by Sylvester's rank inequality and Nakayama's lemma.

numbered_results.paper_only: Codimension at least two of the locus where (G) fails, under the numerical conditions (2.1).

numbered_results.paper_only: A finite etale ordered cover of a neighbourhood of L in H, and dim H = r(a+b-2).

numbered_results.covered: No Lean declaration or exact check is assigned.
numbered_results.paper_only: Smoothness, irreducibility and dimension of Y, birationality of the addition map f, codimension at least two of the complement of Y_good, smooth image of Y_good and uniqueness of its decompositions.

numbered_results.covered: No Lean declaration or exact check is assigned.
numbered_results.paper_only: For an S2 local domain essentially of finite type over C, a height-one prime containing the conductor below every point where the conductor is proper.

numbered_results.paper_only: The coordinate description (4.4) of the elements of L.
